| gate | what it measures | on failure |
|---|---|---|
| `check_release_relationships()` | every declared primary key unique and non-NULL; every non-NULL foreign key resolving; written to `integrity.json` | **stops the release** |
| `check_core_pk_unique()` | the core family's primary keys, before the release-built tables exist (the gate added after v2026.08.25 shipped 4,855 duplicate `sample_key`s) | stops the release |
| `check_cruise_key_integrity()` | `cruise_key` format, its month against the NODC code, the `sample`/`obs` → `cruise` edge, `cruise_uuid` hygiene, every event's date within its cruise's span (± 31 days, named exceptions only), and no derived cruise (one SWFSC has no record of) at a station an SWFSC cruise occupied within 24 hours — the same occupation under a second key, which is how the July 2009 bottle casts sat on `2009-07-31M4` beside `2009-07-33MH` through v2026.10.21 | stops the release; three ratchets (span overlaps, derived cruises, NULL keys per dataset) may only ever go down |
| `check_grid_key_assignment()` | every `sample.grid_key` is the cell of `grid` its position falls in (a shared edge takes the key that sorts first) — the fault a foreign-key check cannot see, because a surviving key name resolves while naming other water | stops the release |
| `check_grid_crosswalk()` | `grid_crosswalk` has every cell of both grids, no repeated pair, no key of neither grid, and each previous cell is covered | stops the release |
| `check_dataset_consent()` | every dataset a public run would release that carries a standing consent question (`related_field = consent` in its `questions.csv`) has it `answered` *yes* with a named respondent — the provider's decision from the private preview, folded into the question by `pull_preview_consent.R`; a preview run exempts the datasets it includes, because the preview is where the decision is made ([Providing data](provide.qmd#what-happens-next)) | stops the release |
| `validate_for_release()` | NULLs in any `*_id` / `*_key` / `*_uuid` column; latitude, longitude and counts in range; no empty table | NULLs stop the release; ranges warn |
| `check_obs_pair_parity()` | `obs_bio` + `obs_env` reproduce `obs` — row counts, distinct ids, a hash of every column, per realm and dataset | stops the release |
| `check_sample_hex7()` | `sample.hex7` is present exactly where the position is finite, is a resolution-7 cell, equals `sample_root.hex7` for every root, and equals the cell of every observation at the same position | stops the release |
| `test_release.qmd` consumer contract | every query shape the apps and packages depend on, run against the frozen release three ways (objects, view, pair), plus the presence of an all-ok `integrity.json` | `latest.txt` is not promoted |
| `test_release.qmd` climatology checks | a per-cast cell exists for a derived product; every monthly `climatology` cell also carries its seasonal baseline; a NULL `depth_bin` occurs only on a per-cast type; one window is stamped on every row; `cruise` carries `date_median` / `month_median` / `season` / `season_year`, a December cruise is DJF of the following year, every `obs_env` row's `quarter` / `cruise_month` / `season_year` match its cruise, and every `obs_env` row of CalCOFI 2607 is in season 3 (JJA) | `latest.txt` is not promoted |
| `test_release.qmd` package examples | the client packages' own README examples — `calcofi4r`'s `README.Rmd` knit, `calcofi4py`'s `README.md` blocks executed — against the frozen release, pointed there by `CALCOFI_RELEASE_VERSION` | `latest.txt` is not promoted |
